basis.important_caveat: The regime bucket itself was selected after M10W17 outcome screening. Therefore all M10W21 historical entry results are research-exposed screening only and require a new independent fresh prospective shadow before support.
basis.why_new_entry_research: M10W17 found stable LONG directionality in this HIGH-ATR aligned-bull regime, while M10W18 found the BLC1 M15 MACD-histogram zero-cross entry was weak specifically in HIGH ATR. The working question is whether entry timing, rather than direction/regime, caused the BLC1 weakness.

common_regime_at_decision: D1 EMA20 > EMA30 > EMA40 using only fully closed D1 bars
H4 EMA20 > EMA30 using only fully closed H4 bars
H1 TORYS MACD line(6,13,4) > 0 using only fully closed H1 bars
H1 Wilder ATR14 percentile rank over trailing 100 fully closed H1 bars >= 0.67

common_execution.decision: Next M15 open immediately after the trigger bar closes
common_execution.entry: Exact M1 at decision timestamp, ask = M1 open + spread_points*point
common_execution.exit: Exact M1 240 minutes after entry, bid = M1 open

HBR1_LONG_HIGH_ATR_1H_BREAKOUT.concept: Momentum continuation using price structure rather than BLC1 MACD-histogram zero-cross.
HBR1_LONG_HIGH_ATR_1H_BREAKOUT.trigger: On the just-closed M15 bar, close is strictly above the maximum HIGH of the immediately preceding four fully closed M15 bars.

HER1_LONG_HIGH_ATR_EMA20_RECLAIM.concept: Pullback recovery using price/EMA reclaim rather than BLC1 MACD-histogram zero-cross.
HER1_LONG_HIGH_ATR_EMA20_RECLAIM.trigger: Previous fully closed M15 close <= previous M15 EMA20, current just-closed M15 close > current M15 EMA20, and current M15 EMA20 > current M15 EMA30.

HRC1_LONG_HIGH_ATR_RCI9_OVERSOLD_TURN.concept: Oversold pullback turn using the pre-existing project/manual RCI9 -80 reference rather than BLC1 MACD-histogram zero-cross.
HRC1_LONG_HIGH_ATR_RCI9_OVERSOLD_TURN.trigger: Previous fully closed M15 RCI9 <= -80 and current just-closed M15 RCI9 > previous M15 RCI9.

screening_tiers.WEAK_OR_INCONSISTENT: Any family not meeting ROBUST_RESEARCH_SCREEN unless REJECT applies.
screening_tiers.REJECT: Any adequately populated split PF <= 1.0, or all-sample fixed0p20 PF <= 1.0, or all-sample +2bps PF <= 1.0.
screening_tiers.INSUFFICIENT_DENSITY: Any split has fewer than 20 resolved trades.

frozen_evaluation.multiple_hypothesis_policy: Exactly these three frozen families are screened. Do not add variants after results, do not combine triggers after results, do not choose new thresholds, and do not alter the 240-minute horizon. Any family passing ROBUST/STRONG may only advance to a brand-new fresh prospective multi-arm shadow; historical ranking is not final support.

explicitly_forbidden_after_results: change EMA20/EMA30 periods or reclaim definition
alter M10W19 BLC1 or its fresh start
